name: Quantum
paragraphs: Quantum creates the illusion of an animated light trail in front of or behind a layer. Customize the effect for speed, complexity, and looping shimmer animations before or behind your on-screen elements to really make your titles or graphics pop with vibrance!
Discover a seeming multiverse of multifarious presets already bundled within Quantum. Find these via the blue Open Dashboard... button or the Choose a Preset... button below it.
As with all other Universe tools, you can modify or create a Quantum look and then save it under its own name by pressing the Save Preset... button.
